collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The children hold their own meeting about play areas and chores: take their ideas seriously, or treat it as a game.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has called a children's assembly under the fig tree. The children have three demands: a safe swimming spot, fewer chores on festival days, and a rule that adults must knock before entering the children's hut. (friend) has been sent to hear them. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) brings the demands to the adults' gathering. The swimming spot is agreed at once. The chores are argued about. The knocking rule passes, to (friend)'s surprise. The children are very solemn about their victory.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) smiles and says the adults will think about it. The children see through it immediately. The next assembly, they bring a carved list and demand an answer. (friend) brings it to the gathering after all.
